name: FineWeb
description: FineWeb is a 15-trillion token dataset derived from Common Crawl snapshots designed to improve the quality of pretraining data for large language models. It includes FineWeb-Edu, a 1.3-trillion token subset focused on educational text, which enhances LLM performance on knowledge- and reasoning-intensive benchmarks.
evaluation_method: downstream benchmark performance (measured as accuracy or other task-specific metrics on held-out evaluation suites)
general_score_metric: composite downstream performance (accuracy delta across evaluated tasks)
reputation: Widely used as a large-scale web pretraining corpus and a common reference for high-quality data filtering in LLM training.
notes: Focuses on dataset creation and curation for LLM pretraining; releases data curation codebase and models.
